intent: A small count or status text at the trailing end of one menu row.
typical_uses: An unread count beside a navigation row

dont_use_when.situation: A status label anywhere outside a sidebar menu row

invariants.text: The badge is absolutely positioned 4px from the item's right edge and vertically centred on the row, at least 20px wide in tabular figures; it takes no pointer events and is not displayed in the icon rail.
While its item's SidebarMenuButton is hovered or active, the badge switches to the row's accent foreground color.
The badge is a plain div beside the button, so its text is not part of the button's accessible name.

rtl.by: sidebar.module.css positions .menuBadge with the physical `right` property, so it stays on the right edge under a right-to-left direction

bad.title: A badge used as a button
bad.why: The badge takes no pointer events and is not focusable, so the handler never runs; use a SidebarMenuAction for an action.
